## 2. Shared Conventions

### Release 0.45.6 family subscription inheritance

An eligible active non-owner family member consumes the active owner subscription without a personal card. PWA access resolves to `mode=active`, `access_scope=family_full` and no payment recommendation/banner; bot returns `family_full`. Canonical owner eligibility, owner expiry and membership revocation remain authoritative. No user identity may be supplied through query/body to obtain this entitlement. Actual production access decisions were verified read-only, not through an impersonated session or payment. Existing financial confirmation and transfer/FX rules remain unchanged. The preexisting bot sponsor handling of banned/mismatched owners remains a separately documented follow-up.
